jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Recruiting
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. About the People Team:  The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business. About the Role: As Senior Manager, Technical Recruiting, you’ll lead recruiting across EMEA, guiding a high-performing team that helps Affirm attract exceptional Engineering talent and scale internationally. Your work will strengthen our global hiring strategy and enable the teams advancing Affirm’s mission. What You’ll Do: Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters by setting clear expectations, providing thoughtful feedback, and fostering a high-performing, inclusive team culture Own the recruiting strategy for EMEA, aligning regional hiring plans with business priorities and building the capabilities needed to support Affirm s continued international growth Partner with Technical and cross-functional leaders to translate hiring plans into scalable hiring strategies across teams and geographies Influence Director and VP-level stakeholders through recruiting data, market insights, and strategic guidance to inform hiring decisions, build alignment, and proactively mitigate talent risks Use recruiting analytics to identify trends, improve funnel performance, forecast hiring risks, and drive continuous improvement across the hiring process Collaborate closely with Talent Brand, Talent Operations, Compensation, and other People teams to deliver a seamless, consistent hiring experience

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Cosuno Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in. Your mission As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who . What you will achieve in your first 12 months You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract. You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies. You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use. You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts. You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire. jobs.title: Lead Recruitment Consultant
jobs.description: Step up from billing into market leadership with a founding Swiss desk. If you’re a top-performing recruiter ready to move into a leadership-focused role, NonStop Consulting is offering the platform to do it. Following 15 successful years operating in Zug, we are expanding into Lucerne —and seeking a Lead Recruitment Consultant to help steer and scale this new division. This position is designed for an experienced recruiter who wants to manage key relationships, lead market strategy, and position themselves at the front of the line for team management as the office expands. What The Role Offers Leadership Trajectory: Direct, rapid route into team management, division head, or account director roles as the Lucerne office grows. Ground-Floor Ownership: Take a lead role in shaping office culture, client strategy, and market coverage from day one. Uncapped Financial Rewards: Highly competitive commission structure designed to heavily reward top commercial drivers. Collaborate with 1M+ CHF Billers: Work alongside elite performers who consistently bill over 1 Million CHF annually across the business. Corporate Backing: Enjoy the freedom of building a new desk with full systems, infrastructure, and financial backing from an established international company. HQ Immersion: Hands-on leadership and strategic training at our Prague headquarters alongside high performers from across Europe. What We’re Looking For We need an ambitious recruiter ready to step up and take ownership of a growing market. Billing History: Strong track record of individual recruitment billing ( 250k CHF+ annually). Account & Market Management: Experience generating new business, managing client relationships, and driving revenue independently. Leadership Potential: The commercial drive and interpersonal skills to mentor others, build a desk, and grow into formal leadership. Languages: Fluent English is required. Professional/Fluent German is strongly preferred; French is a plus. Find Jobs in Switzerla
